title: A World, Gathered
ready: An adult glowing snail can guide the journey. Tend the garden while it explores.
trip_progress: Your snail is exploring beyond the garden. Back in about {0} seconds.
need_bloom: Grow a flower first. Its scent leads beyond the hollow.
need_water: Let a dew beetle carry water from the pond to a seed to discover the next path.
need_pollination: Grow a blue flower, then switch on the lights so a moth can carry pollen.
need_explorer: An adult glowing snail must be in the garden to guide an expedition.
expedition_hint: The flower's scent leads farther away. Click the hollow on the right to explore.
water_hint: Unpack the pond and dew beetle. Watch it carry water to a seed.
pollination_hint: Moths visit flowers when the lights are on. What color grows beside water?
breed_hint: Place pillow moss beside a pond and turn the lights off. Two adult snails can nest there.
colors_hint: Try growing flowers beside moonstone. A young snail and three flower colors change the night.
harmony_hint: A little ecosystem has taken root. Try another arrangement or explore again.
water_source: A place for beetles to gather water.
soft_nest: Beside water, it becomes a soft nest for snails.
moonlit: Its light changes the colors of seeds and snails.
moon_sleep: Turn the lights off to awaken the moonlight inside.
nesting: Gathering at a soft moss nest.
hatching: A small life is growing on the moss.
egg_waiting: Place it beside pillow moss to help it grow.
beetle_waiting: Looking for a pond or a thirsty flower.
moth_resting: Resting with folded wings in the dark.
moth_waiting: Waiting for a flower to open.
found_flower_amber: A golden flower opened in the warmth. Click the hollow to begin an expedition.
found_flower_blue: A flower raised with water has turned blue.
found_flower_moon: A flower opened violet under moonlight.
found_flower_pearl: Different pollen met, and the flower turned pearly.
found_expedition_pond: A pond and dew beetle came back from the shore. Use the arrows to browse your pouch.
found_expedition_meadow: A moth and pillow moss came back from the meadow. Find them in your pouch.
found_expedition_moon: Moonstone and seeds came back from the moonwoods.
found_return_trip: Your snail brought another find and a seed for the pouch.
found_watering: The beetle watered a flower. The path to the meadow is now open.
found_pollination: The moth carried pollen. Flowers can now set fresh seeds.
found_seed_cycle: A flower produced a seed. Continued pollination will produce more.
found_egg: A little egg appeared in the moss beside the water.
found_hatched: A young snail hatched, carrying its parents' light and color.
found_grown: A garden-born snail is now an adult. It can guide expeditions too.
found_shell_blue: Time beside the water has turned a snail's shell blue.
found_shell_moon: A snail beside moonstone has absorbed its color.
found_harmony: New life and many flower colors have brought a gentle light over the garden.
first_hint: Place the warmstone near the snail, then turn off the light. Drag things to move them.
grass_hint: What happens if you place grass beside a glowing snail?
cave_hint: Something is tucked inside the little hollow on the right. Bring a glowing snail closer.
seed_hint: Seeds from the hollow. Try a warm spot beside some grass.
quiet_hint: The garden is moving on its own. Rearrange things and watch how they respond.
place_hint: {0}: click a spot in the garden. Escape cancels.
found_glow: A light has settled in the snail's shell. It stays even after leaving the stone.
found_following: The grass has lifted its roots and begun following the snail.
found_seed: The snail found two seeds in the hollow. Take them from the tray below.
found_bloom: A flower opened in the warm grass. Its light now draws the grass closer.
marked: This moment has been recorded for development feedback.
warm: A gentle warmth spreads when the lights are off.
cool: A cool, smooth stone for now.
glowing: Taking a stroll with a light in its shell.
rooted: Resting with its roots in the soil.
following: Moving gently toward a nearby light.
blooming: A soft light spills from the flower.
waiting: Waiting for a warm spot beside the grass.
